subject: Orion AI adoption timeline & pricing triggers
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jenna Morales <jenna@orionai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-02-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Orion AI adoption timeline & pricing triggers

Hi Jenna —

Great to meet last week. As promised, I put together a short staged adoption plan that ties pricing and committed capacity to MAP milestones so we can both align incentives as you move from evaluation -> pilot -> production. Attached: Orion_MAP_v1.pdf (draft). Key points: 

- POC (2–3 weeks): lightweight evaluation, no commit, usage-based pricing.
- Pilot (30–60 days): initial commit for reserved capacity (X GPUs equivalent) with a 10% pilot discount if pilot adoption meets the success criteria in section 2.
- Production ramp (quarterly commits): tiered discounts at 6/12/18 month commits tied to committed throughput (QPS/token volumes).

Immediate asks from your side: confirm procurement timeline, success criteria you want measured during pilot, and whether legal prefers a redline-first or PO-first path.

If that looks reasonable I can: 1) drop a SOW draft, 2) produce a pricing grid mapping committed units to discounts, and 3) propose target dates so we can lock resources.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call tomorrow to finalize the MAP.

— Dylan Brooks
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
D: (415) 555-0198
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Orion_MAP_v1.pdf (PDF, 92 KB)

From: Jenna Morales <jenna@orionai.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@orionai.com>
Date: 2027-02-15T12:47:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Orion AI adoption timeline & pricing triggers

Thanks Dylan — this is helpful. A few quick clarifications: 

1) Procurement timeline: were aiming to have paperwork signed by mid-March but that depends on pricing and security review.
2) For the pilot discount: can you confirm whether the 10% is applied to list or to the committed reservation?
3) At renewal were likely to ask about uplift credits if usage exceeds the committed baseline — can that be included in the MAP as a conditional?

Procurement looped in here (procurement@orionai.com) — theyll take the lead on contractual milestones. Also legal will want to see the MSA with data residency/audit log clauses.

Would appreciate a pricing grid and the SOW draft so our internal stakeholders can review. Can you also confirm support SLA for pilot?

Best,
Jenna
VP Product, Orion AI

On 2027-02-15 at 09:12, Dylan Brooks wrote:
> Great to meet last week. As promised, I put together a short staged adoption plan...

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jenna Morales <jenna@orionai.com>, Procurement <procurement@orionai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-02-16T08:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Orion AI adoption timeline & pricing triggers

Thanks for the quick reply, Jenna. Quick answers inline and next steps below.

- Pilot discount: 10% off the effective reservation rate (not list). We track the pilot against the usage SLOs in the MAP and apply the discount to the first billing period following pilot close.
- Uplift credits at renewal: yes, we can structure a renewal credit that accrues if production usage exceeds the committed baseline by tiered thresholds (5%, 15%, 30%). Well catalog those in the pricing grid.
- SLA for pilot: 99.5% availability target for the reserved pool, with dedicated support during ramp.

Proposed immediate deliverables (I can have these by EOD tomorrow):
1) SOW_draft_Orion.docx (scope, success criteria, pilot plan)
2) pricing_grid_RWD-3871.xlsx (mapping committed units -> discount bands and renewal uplift credits)
3) Updated MAP PDF with target milestone dates and acceptance criteria.

Suggested timeline:
- 2/18: finalize MAP and SOW for stakeholder review
- 2/22: pricing review with your procurement/finance
- 2/28: legal redline window closes
- 3/15: expected PO / kickoff

If youd like I can also propose a canary fallback policy (smaller model variant) so your product teams can continue testing during unexpected capacity events.

Let me know which items you need first.

— Dylan

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-02-16T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Orion AI adoption timeline & pricing triggers

Dylan / Marissa — looping in a quick commercial note from RevOps side (deal RWD-3871). I prepared the pricing grid and added a conditional renewal uplift credit structure in tab "Renewal Credits". High level: 

- Pilot: 10% off reservation rate (as noted) applied to pilot invoice if success criteria met.
- Production tiers: 5% / 12% / 20% discounts at commit levels A/B/C respectively.
- Renewal uplift credit: if year-over-year usage exceeds committed baseline by >=15%, customer earns a credit equal to 8% of incremental usage for first renewal year (applied to the renewal invoice).

I attached pricing_grid_RWD-3871.xlsx and a redlines cheat sheet for legal. We should reserve the "uplift credit" language for commercial terms and keep renewal mechanics in the MAP appendix.

Also recommend we offer a one-time "onboarding credit" to help with initial consumption spikes — $10k applied to first invoice if onboarding milestones are met.

— Ben
Director, Revenue Operations

Attachment: pricing_grid_RWD-3871.xlsx (XLSX, 48 KB)

From: Jenna Morales <jenna@orionai.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@orionai.com>, legal@orionai.com
Date: 2027-02-18T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Orion AI adoption timeline & pricing triggers

Thanks everyone — this lines up with our internal expectations. A few action items from our side: 

- Legal will send redlines by 2/28 (we prefer to redline MSA first).
- Procurement expects to issue a PO by 3/15 if redlines are acceptable.
- We need confirmation on audit log retention and whether Private deployment (VPC) is available for pilot-sensitive workloads. Please include a short note in the SOW about data handling and KMS integrations.

If you can get the SOW and final pricing grid into our shared doc (link below) Ill route to product and finance for sign-off. Once legal confirms timeline Ill lock the kickoff week.

Appreciate the clarity — looking forward to closing this as a phased adoption.

Best,
Jenna
VP Product, Orion AI
